sources.statement: Embry may be unsure whether she is keeping Kai emotionally central or allowing him to become partial and mediated while another figure occupies her immediate attention.
Embry may believe she has remained literally truthful with Kai while still recognizing that her framing may have led him to misread her emotional availability.
Embry's relationship with Kai may be experienced as continuous but filtered through unresolved attention to James and other observers rather than through a simple one-to-one bond.
Embry may fear that Kai would interpret her closeness with James as replacement, even if she believes she can truthfully deny that anything overt has happened.
